Saffire-I S1 supplies the 1.8 mm/s orbital rate. Rover travel and cabin oxygen are calculated for the selected conditions.

The orbital study used cotton–fiberglass. Applying its rate to a different material, atmosphere or gravity is an assumption. Ignition, sustained spread and flight qualification need separate measurements.
